name: my-custom-plugin/verification-box
title: Verification / Audit Box
description: Trust verification box with an angled corner badge, criteria checklist, and testing limitations.

attributes.section1Intro: We reviewed each provider against practical buying criteria:
attributes.checksList:
Official pricing, free-trial terms, and refund policy
Live channel counts, VOD depth, and category quality
Playback stability, server response, and app compatibility
attributes.section2Text: Performance can vary by region, ISP, connection speed, and device.

section1Intro.default: We reviewed each provider against the same practical buying criteria for German viewers. Our checks covered:

checksList.default:
Official pricing, free-trial terms, and available refund information
Listed live channel counts, VOD depth, and German content categories
Picture quality options and peak-hour playback behavior
Common television, mobile, desktop, and streaming-device compatibility
Activation flow, connection limits, navigation, and support availability

section2Text.default: We did not independently verify distribution rights for every live channel or VOD title. Performance can vary by German region, internet provider, connection speed, device, application, server load, and subscription tier. Large catalog figures are provider claims. Test your preferred categories during the trial and confirm current licensing, prices, refund exclusions, and connection rules before paying.
